name: wasm2c
install-command: git clone --depth 1 --recursive https://github.com/WebAssembly/wabt && cd wabt && mkdir build && cd build && cmake .. && cmake --build .
desc: A tool to convert WebAssembly binary files to C. Does not support WASI.
_comment: wabt turned exceptions, tail-call, memory64, multi-memory and simd on by default and deleted their --enable- spellings, so the old flags made wasm2c exit 1 and the runtime failed to install. The three --enable- flags below are the only ones wasm2c still accepts; function-references, gc and code-metadata are absent from its supported_features[], so --enable-all is rejected outright. The generated main.c must also invoke the module's entry export: it previously only instantiated and freed the module, which meant a successful run measured process startup rather than the benchmark.
